skills: Up to 4 Wind hits. The 4th hit builds 20 Flow and dodges as it starts: dodging an attack with it raises it to Raging Whirlwind's multipliers and adds 15 Flow. Invulnerable on the 4th hit. Dash Attack, Dodge Counter and Spontaneity don't break the combo.

Triggers by itself when he's hit as one of the first three Basic hits starts, or when Shadowflash dodges a hit for him: a dash dealing massive Wind DMG. Builds 15 Flow, +20 on hit. Hold Basic to go straight into Azure Wind's Shadowhunt, whose final hit adds 20 Flow. Invulnerable.
Spends 100 Flow (hold Basic): a backstep, then nonstop darting slashes for massive Wind DMG. The backstep dodges: dodging a hit triggers Vital View and +15 Flow. Invulnerable.
Quick dash dodge. A Perfect Dodge with it gives 15 Flow (once per 0.5s). Invulnerable.
After a Perfect Dodge with Windshift: a quick Wind slash. Triggers by itself if you swap him out right after. Invulnerable.
Hold Dodge after a back dodge to taunt the enemy.
Dashes in with claw strikes and slashes for Wind DMG. Invulnerable.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze. Invulnerable.
Slashes, claw strikes and cannon fire for Wind DMG. Invulnerable.
With Windborne, in combat, switch him in for a powerful Wind slash. Counts as a Quick Assist, not a heavy attack. Invulnerable.
Slashes and stabs forward for Wind DMG.

Costs Energy: a slash, claw and cannon combo for massive Wind DMG, gaining 1 Shadowflash. Hold before the cannon to keep spending Energy on wind blades; spending the maximum gives 1 more Shadowflash. Invulnerable.
A series of attacks for massive Wind DMG, then +35 Flow. Invulnerable.
Several rapid slashes for massive Wind DMG, then +100 Flow. Invulnerable.

core.name: Endless Breeze
core.text:
CRIT DMG +55% and DMG +22.9%, plus another +27.5% DMG with another Wind Agent in the squad.
Using Swift Edge just before he's hit dodges the attack: during the first three hits it launches Raging Whirlwind; on the 4th it raises that hit to Raging Whirlwind's multipliers.
Entering the field gives 2 Shadowflash (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). With Shadowflash (max 2) and not invulnerable, a non-Control hit he fails to dodge or parry uses 1 stack to dodge it automatically and launch Raging Whirlwind. Gaining Shadowflash at max gives 1 Windborne instead and upgrades his next Swift Edge to Raging Whirlwind.
These dodges all count as Perfect Dodges. Each Perfect Dodge gives 1 Windborne, which lets him switch in with his Entry Skill.
Hitting with certain skills or Perfect Dodging builds Flow (max 150); at 100, hold Basic to spend it on Azure Wind's Shadowhunt.
Core Skill Base → F (total by F): CRIT DMG +28.8% and Base ATK +75.

ability.name: Optimal Setup
ability.text: Each 1% CRIT Rate gives +8.5 ATK, up to 100% CRIT Rate.

mindscapes: Double Espresso: Chain Attack gives 50 Flow. Entering with Clear Out uses a Chain Attack instead (still a non-heavy entry; once per 60s). Each Azure Wind's Shadowhunt gives 1 Windborne. His hits ignore 15% Wind RES.
Reins of Reason: entering the field restores 150 Flow (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). Perfect Dodges and Azure Wind's Shadowhunt give +20% PEN Ratio for 25s.
The Last Light: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
Between Light and Shadow: entering combat or switching in gives +10% ATK for 30s. Raging Whirlwind and Azure Wind's Shadowhunt give +10% Decibel generation for 15s.
A Heart Above 0℃: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
Beneath a Little Star: Flow cap 180, and entering the field restores 180. Azure Wind's Shadowhunt's final hit gets a fixed +350% multiplier and grants Rising Wind: +5 Flow per second for 5s.
